The diff deletes the only place that phrase appeared in clutch/specs/ask/plan-ticket-drain.md, the Before you start bullet. The new Closing text says only "never run `clutch release bump`, ...", with no `--minor`. The assertion therefore fails, so `./dev.py test tests/integration/test_ask_plan_drain.py` (criterion 6) and the full suite (criterion 8) fail. Criterion 6 also forbids any instruction to run `clutch release bump`, so pinning that phrase works against the ticket.
